title: Das Mobilitätsskelett
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Seemingly detached from attractive mobility alternatives in cities the car remains highly relevant in personal mobility. In order to investigate the role of the car, a new survey concept for a multidimensional analysis of urban mobility is presented: the travel skeleton. The modular design combines the collection of everyday trips in a typical week with occasional long-distance trips in a quasi-longitudinal approach. The concept also captures associated psychographic characteristics.
